column1: # Ge I — NIST ASD, captured 2026-08-14, register 1639.
# destination_url VERIFIED — spectrum=Ge+I confirmed. Levels in cm-1.
# CAPTURE ONLY. Nothing extracted per R 1638.
# ** THE DEEPEST SERIES IN THE PROJECT. The 4s2.4p.nd series runs to
#    n = 70 on the lower limit and n = 64 on the upper; ns runs to 43.
#    Nothing else captured comes near — Sc I reached 38, Ge II 11. **
# ** AND ALMOST ALL OF IT IS jj-COUPLED: terms read (1/2,1/2)*,
#    THIS IS THE EIGHTH ORTHOGRAPHY IN THIS FETCH and the first that is
#    PURE jj: a (j_core, j_electron) pair. Racah 2[K] appears too, on the
#    nf series. Ge I therefore carries THREE notations at once — LS at
#    low n, Racah on f, jj above n=6.
#    ** THE jj BLOCK IS NOT TRANSCRIBED. It is ~350 rows the index
#       cannot key. Its structure is recorded here so the reading pass
#       knows exactly what is there, and register 1602's jK instrument
# THE LS-KEYABLE BLOCK, transcribed in full below:
# Three rows carry a BARE ASTERISK term (parity only) and one has an
